dex.text: Has a face on the front and another on the back, and they have not agreed about anything in two thousand years. You cannot sneak up on it. You cannot win an argument with it either, because it takes both sides.
dex.fact: The Janus figure in Caldragh graveyard on Boa Island, Lower Lough Erne, is a carved stone with two faces set back to back, perhaps 2,000 years old; Boa may take its name from Badhbh, a war goddess of Irish legend.
